item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find a reliable 2024 source showing Khamenei took any affirmative step to protect independent media, reduce censorship, or improve information access. I also did not surface a strong 2024 source specifically on media ownership pressure, newsroom closures, internet throttling, or a named propaganda campaign tied to Khamenei; the best evidence available is indirect but consistently negative.","evidence":[{"title":"Iran: Chokehold on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-11","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/01/11/iran-chokehold-dissent","summary":"HRW described retaliation against critics and explicitly included journalists among those targeted by arrests, intimidation, and coercive state action.
